Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Select Case which
    Case 0: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 1: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 2: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 3: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 4: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 5: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 6: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 7: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 8: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 9: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 10: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddLine(10, 10, 110, 50)
    Case 11: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 12: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 13: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 14: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 15: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 16: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 17: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 18: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 19: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 20: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 21: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 22: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 23: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 24: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 25: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 26: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    Case 27: Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 100, 40)
    End Select
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 3
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22
    Case 4
        sh.Fill.Patterned 1
    Case 5
        sh.Fill.Patterned 54
    Case 6
        sh.Fill.Patterned 0
    Case 7
        sh.Fill.Patterned 55
    Case 8
        sh.Fill.Patterned -2
    Case 9
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22
    Case 10
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22
    Case 11
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(255, 0, 0)
    Case 12
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.BackColor.RGB = RGB(0, 0, 255)
    Case 13
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(255, 0, 0): sh.Fill.BackColor.RGB = RGB(0, 0, 255)
    Case 14
        sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(255, 0, 0): sh.Fill.Patterned 22
    Case 15
        sh.Fill.BackColor.RGB = RGB(0, 0, 255): sh.Fill.Patterned 22
    Case 16
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.Patterned 48
    Case 17
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(255, 0, 0): sh.Fill.Patterned 48
    Case 18
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.ForeColor.ObjectThemeColor = 6
    Case 19
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.BackColor.ObjectThemeColor = 6
    Case 20
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.ForeColor.Brightness = 0.4
    Case 21
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.Transparency = 0.5
    Case 22
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.Visible = msoFalse
    Case 23
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.Visible = msoFalse: sh.Fill.Visible = msoTrue
    Case 24
        sh.Fill.Visible = msoFalse: sh.Fill.Patterned 22
    Case 25
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.Solid
    Case 26
        sh.Fill.Patterned 22: sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = RGB(255, 0, 0): sh.Fill.Solid
    Case 27
        sh.Fill.Pattern = 22
    End Select
    s = "ok"
Measured:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.Visible
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.Pattern
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.Transparency
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.ForeColor.ObjectThemeColor
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.ForeColor.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.ForeColor.Brightness
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.BackColor.RGB
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.BackColor.ObjectThemeColor
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = sh.Fill.BackColor.Type
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Measured
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 27
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
